svg.title: Standard-atmosphere verification differences
svg.desc: The left panel shows absolute relative differences from fluids 1.3.1 in parts per million. The right panel shows absolute differences divided by official printed-cell tolerances.
svg.text: The official line is a strict diagnostic; the software comparison uses dimensionless relative differences.

g.aria-label: Difference relative to official printed tolerance
